h1: Custom 30 Stem Bandages for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 30 stem bandages in bulk for first aid kits or giveaways. Perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 30 stem bandages are ideal for first aid kits, safety giveaways, or promotional events where you need a compact, ready-to-use solution. Each stem holds 30 adhesive bandages in a convenient dispenser, making them perfect for break rooms, job sites, or welcome packets. Choose from patterned or solid color bandages to match your brand, and add your logo for a practical, everyday reminder of your company.
heroAltText: Custom 30 stem bandages in a dispenser with assorted colors and patterns for branding
